nodes.text: Is it true that for all large $n$ there exists $k$ such that $n+k$ is composite and\[p(n+k)>k^2,\]where $p(m)$ is the least prime factor of $m$?

#681 : [Er79d] number theory | primes Related to questions of Erdős, Eggleton, and Selfridge. This may be true with $k^2$ replaced by $k^d$ for any $d$. See also [680] and [682] .
